{{Quote|You know, Leia, I'm glad our assignment for the Rebellion took us here to Iskalon. It's beautiful!|[[Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 74">[[Star Wars (1977) 74|''Star Wars'' (1977) 74]]</ref>}}
'''Iskalon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
It was inhabited by members of 17 aquatic races relocated from their original [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], collectively united as "[[Iskalonian]]s." In the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Iskalon was often raided for water-breathing [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]], a group of Imperial fighters known as the [[Bane Brigade]] and their Sith commanders attacked the planet.

During the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the sea levels on the planet dropped, revealing several long-hidden [[Cave/Legends|caves]] that had been occupied hundreds of years before and eventually someone was sent to investigate them, discovering that the caves had been used by the native [[Species/Legends|species]] to hide from [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and their possessions could still be found inside the cave network.<ref name="SWTOR" />

Around five hundred years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], a number of needy Iskalonian locals were approached by recruiters sent by [[Hugo Bartyn]]. Bartyn wanted amphibian fishermen to settle a new city in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] and tempted these poverty-stricken individuals with promises of untouched seas in a new frontier. Once they arrived, however, they became slave laborers.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

[[File:Iskalon.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] on Iskalon.]]

The Iskalonians built a city called [[Pavillion]] for interaction with non-water breathers, but the city was destroyed in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] by the [[Iskalon Effect]], a huge tidal wave created by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Subjugation of the Iskalon system|attack]] meant to kill [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The attack also destroyed a small [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] colony. After the disaster, the Iskalonians largely withdrew from [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] affairs. Regardless, Luke helped the planet later on, when he and local hero [[Kiro]] [[Battle of Iskalon (Nagai–Tof War)|destroyed]] the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] presence on Iskalon. However, the Iskalonians refused to join the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

The [[chiaki]] sea creatures also hailed from Iskalon.

==Behind the scenes==
In the Japanese [[Star Wars (1987 video game)|''Star Wars 1987 video game'']] game, after rescuing [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] arrived on Iskalon to rescue [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. Luke had to swim deep underwater to reach where C-3PO was held. Eventually Luke arrived into a chamber where he faced [[Clados Vader]], a shark-like creature who took the form of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. One swipe of Luke's lightsaber and it transformed back into its shark form. After it was defeated, Luke freed C-3PO from the hold he was in and set off for the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] to rescue [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]].<ref name="Star Wars (1987 video game)" />
